firm_trial_check.name: firm_trial_check
firm_trial_check.value: status <> 'TRIAL' or trial_ends_on is not null

firm_deletion_check.name: firm_deletion_check
firm_deletion_check.value: (status = 'PENDING_DELETION') = (deletion_requested_at is not null and status_before_deletion is not null) or status = 'DELETED'

firm_status_before_deletion_check.name: firm_status_before_deletion_check
firm_status_before_deletion_check.value: status_before_deletion is null or status_before_deletion in ('TRIAL', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED')

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (app_can_see_client(client_id) or person_id = app_person_id())

membership_unit_ids_check.name: membership_unit_ids_check
membership_unit_ids_check.value: unit_ids is null or (role in ('OWNER', 'APPROVER') and cardinality(unit_ids) >= 1)

membership_viewer_expiry_check.name: membership_viewer_expiry_check
membership_viewer_expiry_check.value: role <> 'VIEWER' or expires_at is not null

person_email_key.name: person_email_key
person_email_key.where: email is not null and archived_at is null

person_email_lookup_idx.name: person_email_lookup_idx
person_email_lookup_idx.where: email is not null and archived_at is null

tenant_read.name: tenant_read
tenant_read.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (app_firm_staff() or id = app_person_id() or app_person_visible(id))

tenant_update.name: tenant_update
tenant_update.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (app_firm_staff() or ((id = app_person_id() or app_person_visible(id)) and not app_person_has_firm_role(id) and (app_all_clients() or not app_person_in_hidden_client(id))))

person_email_status_check.name: person_email_status_check
person_email_status_check.value: (status <> 'UNCLAIMED' or email is null) and (status not in ('INVITED', 'ACTIVE') or email is not null)

act_jurisdiction_check.name: act_jurisdiction_check
act_jurisdiction_check.value: (jurisdiction = 'STATE') = (state_code is not null) and (state_code is null or state_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$')

obligation_jurisdiction_check.name: obligation_jurisdiction_check
obligation_jurisdiction_check.value: (jurisdiction = 'STATE') = (state_code is not null) and (state_code is null or state_code ~ '^[A-Z]{2,3}$')

assignment_na_reason_check.name: assignment_na_reason_check
assignment_na_reason_check.value: applicability <> 'NOT_APPLICABLE' or na_reason is not null

assignment_active_range_check.name: assignment_active_range_check
assignment_active_range_check.value: active_to is null or active_to >= active_from

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (client_id is null or app_can_see_client(client_id))

audit_event_actor_check.name: audit_event_actor_check
audit_event_actor_check.value: actor_kind <> 'PERSON' or actor_id is not null

compliance_instance_completed_on_check.name: compliance_instance_completed_on_check
compliance_instance_completed_on_check.value: completed_on is not null or not (workflow_state in ('APPROVED', 'NOT_APPLICABLE') or (workflow_state = 'SUBMITTED' and pending_kind = 'COMPLETION'))

compliance_instance_na_reason_check.name: compliance_instance_na_reason_check
compliance_instance_na_reason_check.value: na_reason is not null or not (workflow_state = 'NOT_APPLICABLE' or pending_kind = 'NA')

delete_before_commit.name: delete_before_commit
delete_before_commit.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and exists (select 1 from import_batch b where b.id = batch_id and b.status in ('UPLOADED', 'MAPPED', 'PARSED', 'REVIEWED', 'DRY_RUN_READY'))

import_issue_severity_check.name: import_issue_severity_check
import_issue_severity_check.value: severity = case type when 'PERSON_CASE_MERGE' then 'INFO' when 'PERSON_NEAR_MATCH' then 'WARNING' when 'ENUM_NORMALISED' then 'INFO' when 'UNKNOWN_ENUM' then 'ERROR' when 'ALIAS_DEPARTMENT' then 'WARNING' when 'ALIAS_CATEGORY' then 'WARNING' when 'ALIAS_ACT' then 'WARNING' when 'NULL_PLACEHOLDER' then 'INFO' when 'COMPLIED_WITHOUT_DATE' then 'WARNING' when 'DUPLICATE_PERIOD' then 'WARNING' when 'CONFLICTING_OBLIGATION_VALUE' then 'INFO' when 'RULE_LOW_CONFIDENCE' then 'WARNING' when 'FILE_NOT_ATTACHED' then 'INFO' when 'UNPARSED_EXTERNAL_REF' then 'INFO' when 'INVALID_DATE' then 'ERROR' when 'MISSING_REQUIRED' then 'ERROR' end::issue_severity

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (client_id is null or app_can_see_client(client_id))

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff())
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff())

notification_send_instance_key.name: notification_send_instance_key
notification_send_instance_key.where: instance_id is not null and event_id is null

notification_send_iso_subject_key.name: notification_send_iso_subject_key
notification_send_iso_subject_key.where: iso_subject_id is not null and event_id is null

notification_send_digest_key.name: notification_send_digest_key
notification_send_digest_key.where: instance_id is null and event_id is null and iso_subject_id is null

notification_send_client_check.name: notification_send_client_check
notification_send_client_check.value: client_id is not null or (instance_id is null and (event_id is not null or kind::text in ('TRIAL_ENDING', 'RENEWAL_DUE')))

notification_send_iso_subject_check.name: notification_send_iso_subject_check
notification_send_iso_subject_check.value: (iso_subject_type is null) = (iso_subject_id is null) and (iso_subject_id is not null) = starts_with(kind::text, 'ISO_') and (iso_subject_id is null or (instance_id is null and event_id is null and client_id is not null))

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff())
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff())

auth_credential_mfa_check.name: auth_credential_mfa_check
auth_credential_mfa_check.value: (mfa_enrolled_at is null or mfa_sealed_secret is not null) and (mfa_last_step is null or mfa_last_step >= 0)

tenant_isolation.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff() or (client_id is not null and app_can_see_client(client_id) and exists (select 1 from person p where p.id = person_id) and not app_person_has_firm_role(person_id)))
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff() or (client_id is not null and app_can_see_client(client_id) and exists (select 1 from person p where p.id = person_id) and not app_person_has_firm_role(person_id)))

auth_invite_unit_ids_check.name: auth_invite_unit_ids_check
auth_invite_unit_ids_check.value: unit_ids is null or (role in ('OWNER', 'APPROVER') and cardinality(unit_ids) >= 1)

auth_invite_viewer_expiry_check.name: auth_invite_viewer_expiry_check
auth_invite_viewer_expiry_check.value: role <> 'VIEWER' or membership_expires_at is not null

auth_invite_closed_check.name: auth_invite_closed_check
auth_invite_closed_check.value: accepted_at is null or revoked_at is null

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff())
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff())

auth_session_method_check.name: auth_session_method_check
auth_session_method_check.value: (method in ('PASSWORD', 'MAGIC_LINK', 'INVITE') and support_grant_id is null) or (method = 'SUPPORT' and support_grant_id is not null)

tenant_isolation.name: tenant_isolation
tenant_isolation.using: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff() or (invite_id is not null and exists (select 1 from auth_invite i where i.id = invite_id)))
tenant_isolation.withCheck: firm_id = app_firm_id() and (person_id = app_person_id() or app_firm_staff() or (invite_id is not null and exists (select 1 from auth_invite i where i.id = invite_id)))

auth_token_kind_check.name: auth_token_kind_check
auth_token_kind_check.value: (kind = 'MAGIC_LINK' and invite_id is null and support_grant_id is null) or (kind = 'INVITE' and invite_id is not null and support_grant_id is null) or (kind = 'SUPPORT' and invite_id is null and support_grant_id is not null)

usage_snapshot_counts_check.name: usage_snapshot_counts_check
usage_snapshot_counts_check.value: companies >= 0 and units >= 0 and users >= 0 and storage_bytes >= 0 and active_users_30d >= 0 and instances >= 0

certification_issued_check.name: certification_issued_check
certification_issued_check.value: (issued_on is null) = (expires_on is null) and (issued_on is null) = (certificate_number is null) and (expires_on is null or expires_on > issued_on)

clause_assessment_na_open_check.name: clause_assessment_na_open_check
clause_assessment_na_open_check.value: na_state not in ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED') or (justification is not null and status_before_na is not null and na_requested_by_id is not null)

clause_assessment_na_decided_check.name: clause_assessment_na_decided_check
clause_assessment_na_decided_check.value: (na_decided_by_id is null) = (na_decided_at is null) and (na_state not in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') or (na_decided_by_id is not null and na_decided_by_id is distinct from na_requested_by_id))

controlled_document_external_check.name: controlled_document_external_check
controlled_document_external_check.value: type = 'EXTERNAL' or (issuer is null and external_ref is null)

document_revision_open_key.name: document_revision_open_key
document_revision_open_key.where: state in ('DRAFT', 'IN_REVIEW') and archived_at is null

document_revision_approved_check.name: document_revision_approved_check
document_revision_approved_check.value: (state in ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED')) = (approved_at is not null) and (state in ('APPROVED', 'SUPERSEDED') or approved_by_id is null)

document_revision_approver_check.name: document_revision_approver_check
document_revision_approver_check.value: approved_by_id is null or approved_by_id <> prepared_by_id

external_audit_closed_check.name: external_audit_closed_check
external_audit_closed_check.value: state <> 'CLOSED' or recommendation is not null

management_system_climate_check.name: management_system_climate_check
management_system_climate_check.value: (climate_change_relevant is null) = (climate_change_rationale is null) and (climate_change_relevant is null) = (climate_decided_on is null)
